summary: Live Oak Bancshares filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose that its Chairman and CEO, James S. Mahan III, entered into a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to sell up to 400,000 shares of common stock for personal tax and financial planning. The sales may occur from November 2026 through November 2027. This is a routine disclosure of insider trading arrangements, not a corporate special situation. No transactions, offers, or strategic actions are involved. The filing has no impact on corporate control, capital structure, or shareholder value beyond ordinary insider sales. Watch for Form 4 filings detailing actual sales.
